db_path.description: The file path to the KeePass database (.kdbx) to be used by default.

clipboard_clear.description: Number of seconds to wait before automatically clearing the clipboard after copying a password.

auto_type_key.description: The global hotkey combination to trigger KeePass auto-type.

language_file.description: Path to a specific language translation file (.kpll/.kppx). Leave empty for English.

plugins_dir.description: The system directory path where KeePass2 expects to find installed plugins.
